Where it cannot

A deck under the eaves, a pool against the boundary or an awkward roof line. Then it needs a ladder, and the cost base changes.

How to settle it

A photograph of each elevation answers it before anybody quotes, which is why we ask for four pictures rather than a description.

Balustrade and pool glass

The glass that is not a window

Frameless balustrade

Marks differently from a window because it is handled constantly and it is usually in the weather on both faces.

Pool glass

Carries splash, sunscreen and mineral deposit from the water. It is the glass most often forgotten and the one most on show.

Spigots and fixings

Stainless spigots mark and tea stain, particularly near the bay. Cleaned with the glass rather than left looking worse against it. Balustrade and pool glass.

Screens and tracks

What actually changes the room

The thing that changes how a room looks in an older Preston house is almost never the glass. It is the flyscreen in front of it.

Why they matter more than they should

A screen that has not been washed in a decade carries a film of dust that cuts visible light noticeably. Cleaning the glass behind it and leaving the screen produces very little visible change.

They come out, get washed, and go back. It is real work and it is usually priced separately, which is worth confirming before the day.
